data.abstract: This article introduces the intermittent increase of acetylene content in the oil during the operation of a 500kV start-up substation of a power generation company. It is preliminarily judged that there is spark discharge in the oil chromatographic analysis and on-site partial discharge test. After returning to the factory for maintenance and internal inspection, it was found that the movable contact and the fixed contact of the selected part of the on-load tap-changer were not connected in place, which caused intermittent spark discharge and continued to increase acetylene. The problem is solved by adjusting the number of turns of the gear when the tap switch is switched forward and backward, and the transformer resumes normal operation.

data.abstract: Aiming at the problem of commutation failure caused by impurities contamination in the oil that occurred in the on-load tap-changer, a platform for the test of impurities in the oil of the on-load tap-changer was built, and the breakdown test of the impurities in the oil of the on-load tap-changer was proposed. Methods, the test obtained the breakdown characteristics of the on-load tap-changer in oil with uniform carbon particle contamination, local carbon particle contamination, rust contamination, and paint skin contamination, and revealed the breakdown process of the on-load tap-changer under local carbon particle contamination. The uniform carbon particle pollution, rust pollution and paint pollution will basically not cause the tap changer oil gap breakdown, carry out the core inspection of multiple on-load tap-changers, and found carbon pollution, rust pollution and paint pollution, Suggestions for improving the structure, installation process, operation and maintenance of the on-load tap-changer are put forward, which is an important reference for the structural improvement and failure cause analysis of the on-load tap-changer.

data.abstract: On-load voltage regulating transformers play a crucial role in power systems, not only connecting to the grid but also regulating reactive power and stabilizing loads. The on-load tap-changer (OLTC), as the key component of the on-load regulator, is the only movable part of the transformer, and its reliability is directly related to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Therefore, timely identification of operational defects and rapid localization of mechanical faults in OLTCs through online monitoring is crucial for the operation and maintenance of transformers in the field. In this paper, firstly, the mechanism of on-load tap-changer contact faults is analyzed in depth, and on this basis, a diagnostic method for OLTC contact faults is proposed for the joint analysis of electric-vibrational signal features. Secondly, in order to extract high-quality fault features, the Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) algorithm is used to process the vibration signals and motor current signals to extract the fault features. Meanwhile, their envelope time-domain features are extracted by the Hilbert transform. Finally, the experimentally obtained electric-vibration joint signal features are utilized to deeply analyze the contact state of OLTC and evaluate its fault state.
